items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 49:1
items.html: The openings of the eyes are the GAR of the Bina of the head, and the discernment of the ear is the seven lower Sefirot of the Bina of the head. (ibid.).
